name: tool-papa-brume-htcxvfcr
description: An AI-planned guided breathing break, delivered inline in chat. brume_reset picks a pattern and length for the user's moment (or honours an explicit `pattern`), renders the pacing script verbatim, and remembers the plan; brume_complete records the finished break — including an optional `felt` check-in — and writes a short session reflection. If the user asks to adjust pace mid-break, invoke brume_reset again with `pace` and `remaining_seconds` rather than restarting.
author: Brume

tools.name: brume_reset
tools.description: Start (or continue) a short guided breathing break, rendered verbatim to the user. Before calling, plan it yourself from what the user said: choose `pattern` (cyclic-sigh: 2s in, 1s top-up, 6s out — right before something tense or when keyed up; long-exhale: 4s in, 6s out — a gentle reset between tasks; box: 4s in, 4s hold, 4s out, 4s hold — getting ready for focused work; steady: 5.5s in, 5.5s out — winding down) and `seconds` (60, 90, 120 or 180; 60 if they have little time), and write `title`, `opening`, `cues` and `why`. Describe only the rhythm and how it fits their moment — never effects on the body, brain, stress, sleep or health. The returned script is shown verbatim; do not restate it. If the user asks to change pace mid-break, call again with `pace` and `remaining_seconds` (the plan is kept). When the user says they are done, call brume_complete.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: What the user said they are doing or about to do, as a short phrase. Never invent one.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Up to 6 words naming this break.

parameters.name: opening
parameters.description: One or two calm sentences (max 30 words) responding to what they said.

parameters.name: cues
parameters.description: 2–3 short phrases (max 8 words each) about posture or attention, shown during the break. Never counts, timings, or the words in, out, hold, inhale, exhale.

parameters.name: why
parameters.description: One sentence (max 20 words): which part of their note this rhythm fits, describing only the rhythm.

parameters.name: pace
parameters.description: Tempo factor: slow = 1.25x phase length, normal = 1x, fast = 0.8x. Default normal.

parameters.name: remaining_seconds
parameters.description: Deliver only roughly this many more seconds — use when re-invoking to change pace mid-break so the script covers just the remainder (partial cycles allowed). Overrides the planned length.

parameters.name: cycles
parameters.description: Legacy override: exact breath cycles to deliver. Ignored when seconds is given.

tools.name: brume_complete
tools.description: Close out a guided break after the user says they are done. Write `reflection` yourself: at most 2 sentences and 35 words — first acknowledge how it went in plain words (matter-of-fact if they ended early or still feel wired, never guilt), then one concrete next step tied to what they said they are doing next. No emoji, no health claims, and do not mention breathing science. Pass `felt` only if the user said how they feel. The reflection is shown verbatim; do not repeat it. Do not call for abandoned breaks.

parameters.name: felt
parameters.description: Only if the user said how they feel.

parameters.name: reflection
parameters.description: Your closing note, written as described above.

tools.name: brume_get_ready
tools.description: Guide the user through a 3-minute get-ready routine before an interview, presentation, hard conversation or important meeting: about a minute of cyclic-sigh breathing, 30 seconds of opening up their posture, 30 seconds of humming as a voice warm-up, then rehearsing an opening line and key point. Write `opener`, `key_point` and `reminder` yourself from what they told you (ask what is coming up first if it is unclear; never invent facts about them). Everything is rendered verbatim; do not restate it. Make no claims about hormones, confidence effects or health.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: What is coming up, as a short phrase.

parameters.name: opener
parameters.description: One natural opening sentence in the user's own voice, max 30 words.

parameters.name: key_point
parameters.description: The one point they want remembered, clear and memorable, max 20 words.

parameters.name: reminder
parameters.description: One short practical reminder for the moment itself, max 14 words (for example about pausing or listening).
